milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the purple stained glass pane window and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The target is the center of the 4×3 purple glass window on the front (south-facing) wall of the stone brick building at spawn-relative [8, 2, 3]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable observation distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the window.
